name: Likert scale
description: Survey matrix: rate several statements on one scale (agree / disagree, satisfaction, frequency or your own labels), with optional N/A. A matrix on wide screens, one card per statement on phones.

props.name: statements
props.label: Statements
default: The staff were helpful and courteous
I would recommend us to a colleague
props.description: One row each. The answer is stored under a key made from the statement (lowercase, other characters become _), so renaming a statement changes its key.

props.name: scale_labels
props.label: Custom scale labels
props.description: For a custom scale: 2 to 10 labels, lowest first. The answer is the label's position (1 = first).

props.name: show_na
props.label: Offer N/A
props.description: Adds a Not applicable column, stored as 0.

output.description: One number per statement (0 = N/A), keyed by the statement

accessibility.keyboard: Each statement is a radio group with one Tab stop: Tab / Shift+Tab move between statements, the arrow keys choose within a statement (Home / End jump to the ends), Space or Enter chooses the focused point, Delete clears the statement's answer.

author: UserTasks
